description.value:
Duration constant

When you take a full night's rest, any Reckoning toll that would persist past the ordinary morning reset ends instead, including a Stage IV Major Reckoning's lasting penalty and a permanently carried stage. In addition, the first time each day you would advance to a new Reckoning stage, you do not — the ledger takes the morning to notice.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Reckoning's morning-reset and first-advance-of-the-day suppression -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
